tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A very light neutral grey so white cards sit slightly forward.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, menus: anything that sits on the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Image placeholders in prototypes, quiet bands between sections, filter bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (card outlines, section rules). Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and unselected chips. 3:1 or more on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata (location, beds/baths/area, captions) on any surface. 5.2:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The action grey: primary buttons, links, selected chips and the active language. As text, on any surface or accent-soft (9.3:1 or more). Never decorative. Kept as a separate token so a brand colour can replace it later in one place.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Grey tint behind accent text: selected filter chips, the "New" badge. Not a ground for inputs.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-hover fill (primary button label). 11.4:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors only, in greyscale: a darker, thicker field border plus a written message. The message carries the meaning, never colour.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: an alias of accent, so changing the accent moves links too.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Exposure at a single weight (400). Size and space carry hierarchy, never bold. Tight leading, as specified.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero only. One per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page titles: property name on the detail page, section page titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings and property names on cards. The base Exposure style (26/26, ink).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for everything small: body, data, controls.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and detail pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A quiet four-bedroom home above the bay, ten minutes from town.
styles.usage: Descriptions and long-form text. Keep lines under ~70 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, eyebrow labels above headings, form labels. Set in uppercase.

spacing.note: 4px base. Be generous between sections: white space is the luxury.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked lines in a card (name, location, price).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between cards in a grid; page side margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading and the content it introduces.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, inputs, chips, badges, cards, images, menus.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One elevation for things that float; the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only things that float above the page: menus, the language dropdown, a sticky inquiry bar. Never on cards at rest.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px white gap, then 2px of solid ink (13.9:1 on surface).
